newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH NBP SELLS PLN 300 MLN OF ITS BILLS.
newsitem.headline: POLISH NBP SELLS PLN 300 MLN OF ITS BILLS.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland sold all 150 million zlotys of its 182-day NBP-bills on offer and all 150 million zlotys of 273-day bills, the bank said.

It said the average yield for 182-day paper was 19.71 percent, up from 19.68 percent on Thursday and an average yield of 19.35 percent for comparable 26-week T-bill sold at the last primary auction on Monday.
The average yield of the 273-day paper was 19.81 percent, up from 19.79 percent at the last auction and 20.30 percent for comparable 39-week T-bill, last sold on July 8.
